title: Venezuelan Semolina Empanadas
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish, these semolina empanadas make for a satisfying snack or light meal, perfect for any time of day.
instructions: Preheat a deep frying pan with oil over medium heat.
Combine semolina flour and salt in a large bowl.
Gradually add water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place a tablespoon of cheese filling in the center of each disk, if using.
Fold the dough over to form a half-circle shape and press edges together to seal.
Deep fry the empanadas in batches until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
